title: Mitigation Services Schedule — Water Extraction and Drying on HomeGuard Dwelling Water Damage
content:
Schedule of the water extraction and drying allowance paid on the dwelling water damage of a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim that is settled in place of a repeated-seepage denial.

The allowance is a percentage of the replacement-cost value of the dwelling water damage, added to the reversal payment on the dwelling water damage before the floor at 0.00 and the single rounding to the cent. It is set by the whole days from the date of loss to the report date on the first notice of the claim.

| Whole days from the date of loss to the report date | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 (reported within 2 days) | 8 percent of the replacement-cost value |
| 3 to 7 | 4 percent of the replacement-cost value |
| more than 7 | none — the drying window has passed and the wet materials are replaced instead |

**Counting.** The days are counted as whole calendar days from the date of loss to the report date, both as recorded on the claim's first-notice entry. A report on the date of loss counts as 0 days.

**Boundary lines.**
- Reported 2 days after the loss: 8 percent. Reported 3 days after: 4 percent.
- Reported 7 days after the loss: 4 percent. Reported 8 days after: no allowance.

**Figures (hypothetical).** On dwelling water damage with a hypothetical replacement-cost value of 15000.00, a report 1 day after the loss adds 1200.00 (8 percent); a report 5 days after adds 600.00 (4 percent); a report 10 days after adds nothing.

The replacement-cost value used is the one recorded on the dwelling damage's repeated-seepage denial entry of the claim.
